runs.prompt: Le Chat survives a haunted cheese dungeon full of ghost rats
runs.title: Peculiar Pasture
runs.intro: The cheese dungeon rises in eerie fog. Ghost rats swarm in the shadows—cheese the monsters away while they try to cheese you!
runs.story: The moon glows ominously over misty clover as Le Chat steps into the hollow of crumbling stone, heart pounding against the damp stone.

runs.prompt: Le Chat grows longer eating sardines in a neon maze
runs.title: Neon Serpent’s Labyrinth
runs.intro: A bioluminescent maze pulses with light—each sardine eats a segment. Survive the wrath of the **Glitch** as it slithers through neon veins.
